<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is produced through [[Alchemy]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]]. When used the potion applies the protection potion buff, reducing incoming damage.

==Effect==
On use, the potion will apply the {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} buff for a duration of 5 minutes. This buff reduces all incoming damage. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
